# Functional Execution Benchmarking: Technical Specification

> Rigorous benchmarking framework for measuring agent skill execution fidelity, workspace isolation, execution tracing, token overhead, and differential quality scoring.

## Canonical Docs

- [Evaluating Skill Output Quality](https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills.md): Testing agent outputs with isolated workspaces, baseline comparison, and quantitative grading.
- [Specification](https://agentskills.io/specification.md): Agent skills operational contract and filesystem layout.
- [Best Practices](https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/best-practices.md): Bounding execution side-effects and ensuring reproducibility.

## Architecture & Concepts

- [Workspace Isolation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-full.txt#workspace-isolation): Directory sandboxing (`with_skill/` vs `without_skill/`).
- [Execution Tracing](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-full.txt#execution-tracing): Capturing tool calls, stdout/stderr, token metrics, and execution timing.
- [Delta Scoring](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-full.txt#delta-scoring): Quantifying net performance gain over the default base model baseline.
- [Failure Taxonomy](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-full.txt#failure-taxonomy): Categorizing execution halts, schema violations, assertion misses, and timeouts.
- [Test Fixture Management](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-full.txt#test-fixture-management): Providing idempotent mock files, databases, and input payloads.
